The operating company directly providing the software products and services at **portswigger.net** (including the Burp Suite product family) is **PortSwigger Ltd**.

### Supporting Evidence
* **Website Terms of Use:** 
  > *"These Website Terms of Use together with the documents referred to in it ('Terms') constitute the terms and conditions which govern the use by any visitor or user ('User') of the PortSwigger Ltd (Company registration no. 6719143) ('PortSwigger') website (portswigger.net) and associated websites, tools and products supplied by PortSwigger..."*
* **Legal Information:** 
  > *"Burp Suite Community Edition, Burp Suite Professional, Burp Suite DAST and the Burp Suite Certified Practitioner certification are developed and licensed by PortSwigger Ltd."*
* **Privacy Notice:** 
  > *"PortSwigger Ltd is the controller and responsible for your personal data (collectively referred to as 'PortSwigger', 'we', 'us' or 'our' in this privacy notice)."*
